title: STANDING QUARTERLY (next due 2026-11-10): are frontier-lab handoff and memory conventions getting richer or thinner (Part VI falsification watch)
description: The roadmap's standing monitoring duty (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:106): track whether frontier-lab handoff and memory conventions are getting RICHER (supports the roadmap) or THINNER (undermines it - the prosthesis reading wins, the roadmap inverts, and the omniscient chieftain returns). Quarterly cadence; NEXT DUE 2026-11-10 (this epic was published 2026-08-10). Append-only log at docs/monitoring/part-vi-handoff-conventions.md, owned solely by this task. It has no dependencies, gates nothing, and is deliberately excluded from the epic join T-348 because a standing duty never terminates - gating a join on it would deadlock the epic. Engine any: the reading is citation-bounded, not judgment-bounded.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE, append-only: docs/monitoring/part-vi-handoff-conventions.md (create the docs/monitoring/ directory with mkdir -p). Never rewrite a prior quarter's entry - a monitoring log that can be edited retroactively cannot falsify anything.

THE METRIC IS STRUCTURAL, NOT VOLUMETRIC - this is the load-bearing criterion and it comes from the research-librarian's caveat: 'richer' means MORE STRUCTURAL FIELDS (typed memory tiers, roles, evidence gates, stopping criteria, citation or ID mechanisms, authority distinctions), NOT more tokens. Externalizing harness policy into a natural-language harness SHRINKS the static artifact while making it more formally structured: Live-SWE 60.10k tokens / 68 files down to 2.90k / 3, MHTBA 10.50k/3 down to 0.80k/1, SeeAct 47.50k/5 down to 1.40k/1 (papers/natural_language_agent_harnesses.pdf:6, Table 2; the paper's framing: 'NLAHs expose the reusable harness policy in fewer static materials'). A metric that counts file size or token count would therefore report THINNER exactly when the convention became more constitutional. Record raw token or file-size footprint SEPARATELY and label it explicitly as a NON-SIGNAL.

EACH QUARTERLY ENTRY CONTAINS: the date; the conventions surveyed (named product or lab, named artifact - for example the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md pattern, memory-file tiering, handoff or progress file formats, published harness policy documents) each with a source and a retrieval date; the COUNT of distinct structural field types per convention versus the previous quarter; the raw footprint as a labelled non-signal; and a one-word verdict RICHER / THINNER / FLAT with the specific evidence for it and an explicit statement of what observation would flip that verdict.

EVERY claim tagged ESTABLISHED / ANALOGY / SPECULATION (roadmap Part V principle 5). Cite the two-tier memory convention already in the corpus as the baseline datapoint: agentic-harness-engineering-reference/agents/code_agent_simple/LongTermMEMORY.md:1-3 (persistent facts, conventions, architectural decisions) paired with ShortTermMEMORY.md:1-3 (cleared between sessions) - typed, not undifferentiated.

ALSO TRACK the other Part VI falsification watch item: model-layer memory architectures that demonstrably eliminate the handoff problem, on the roadmap's ~18-month window (from 2026-08-10, so through approximately 2028-02). Record any evidence for or against, with sources.

ESCALATION RULE: a THINNER verdict in two consecutive quarters is a MANDATORY FINDING at the next section 5A evolution audit (the roadmap inverts if the prosthesis reading wins), recorded as an OPEN-QUESTION: note so the audit chases it (ORCHESTRATION.md:79-80). A single THINNER quarter is recorded but does not escalate.

CADENCE MAINTENANCE: at the end of each entry, state the NEXT DUE date (quarterly: 2026-11-10, then 2027-02-10, 2027-05-10, 2027-08-10) and hand off to role verifier for that quarter's verdict. The verifier checks only that sources exist, the metric used is structural rather than volumetric, and the verdict follows from the recorded evidence - doc tier per P-024.

CONSUMES the falsification signals produced by T-337 (the Graeber-Wengrow steelman) and consolidated by T-344 once those exist; until then, track the two Part VI criteria as written in the brief. No code, no source edits (thinker role).

notes.note:
DECISION: T-349 is amended BY NOTE per AB7 (addendum II sections A.8 and C.5), not by rewriting its
acceptance criteria. Its title, description, acceptance criteria and open status are unchanged: a
standing quarterly duty never terminates, so it is never rewritten and never closed. Two indicators
join every quarterly entry from this quarter forward, each with its own verdict rule.

(a) THE A.8 REPUTATION INDICATOR (addendum II section A.8; enacted by the tier-1 record with subject
load-bearing-citation). Each quarter, record two observations and one verdict.

1. CONVERGENCE. The count of citations confirmed load-bearing under the v1 heuristic against the
   count rendered name-drop, or left explicitly not-computed, under the same heuristic. If the two
   counts trend toward each other, citation gaming is succeeding.
2. CONCENTRATION. Whether standing concentrates in one identity without corresponding verified work:
   an identity's authorship and citation figures rising while its producer-distinct verdict count and
   its sustained-overruling count stay flat is rent extraction, not contribution.

VERDICT RULE, binding: if either observation fires, the currency is failing and Phase B does not
ship, regardless of the identity gate. This is a rule, not a recommendation. A quarter in which the
reputation reader exists and nobody ran it is recorded as NOT OBSERVED, never as FLAT.

MEASUREMENT NOTE, recorded so no future quarter fabricates the number: the load-bearing verdict has
no storage field in Phase A, so the convergence ratio is NOT COMPUTABLE from the stores today. Until
a verdict field exists, record (i) the eligible-upper-bound figure the reader prints and (ii) the
count of counterfactual-dependence verdicts recorded in task notes, and label the convergence ratio
NOT COMPUTED with that reason. An estimate here would be exactly the fabrication Phase A forbids.

(b) THE C.5 WESTPHALIA KPI, as a standing definition (addendum II section C.5; enacted by the tier-1
record with subject westphalia-kpi).

OPERATOR BASELINE ON RECORD: approximately 3 months of human effort reconciling architecture and
redundancy differences between two simple systems. That is the cost regime this containment
architecture exists to eliminate, and it is the figure every later measurement is compared against.

MEASURE: the cost to reconcile two diverged domain registries, or two workstreams diverged for N
weeks, in wall-clock hours PLUS tokens. Both halves are required: hours alone hides machine cost,
tokens alone hides human cost.

REPORT: quarterly, in the same entry as this task's Part VI watch and alongside the roadmap Part VI
monitoring duty.

INTERPRETATION RULE: if reconciliation cost trends toward negligible, meaning cheap merges and cheap
context fusion, the containment architecture of Part C is OVER-ENGINEERED and should be simplified:
heresy has become cheap, so tolerance is free. If it stays expensive, Westphalia stands.

MEASURABILITY: this metric is measurable ONLY once two domain registries exist. One registry exists
today, at .harness/precedents, and it is the founding domain. Until a second exists, each quarterly
entry records the KPI as NOT YET MEASURABLE with that reason, never as zero and never omitted.

ESCALATION, in the shape this task's criterion 6 already fixes: an A.8 firing is a MANDATORY FINDING
at the next section 5A evolution audit, recorded as an OPEN-QUESTION: note so the audit chases it.
